name: @midnite/launcher
description: Midnite Apps — the launcher that lists, installs and opens every midnite app. Electron main + preload, Vite + React renderer.

scripts.start: vite build && node scripts/bundle.mjs && node scripts/start-electron.mjs
scripts.dist: vite build && node scripts/bundle.mjs && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
